name: omp-worklog
description: OMP Project Time work logs with an optional manual Harvest destination.

defaultHours.description: Hours per business day when the Harvest tool call omits hours.

holidayRegions.description: Comma-separated Holidays regions; defaults to Yukon, Canada.

command.description: Direct path to the omp-worklog executable; credentials stay in HARVEST_ACCESS_TOKEN and HARVEST_ACCOUNT_ID.

projectTimeMappings.description: Optional JSON mapping from OMP Project Time project names to Harvest project and task names.

projectTimeLogPath.description: Optional Project Time evidence path; defaults to ~/.omp/project-time/time-log.sqlite. A legacy v1 JSON snapshot is also supported.
